answer: Each epoch issues a unique seeded prompt per identity, so answers cannot be copied across the horizon of accounts. A grader panel scores novelty: a smooth velvet re-skin of a prior answer — polished prose, same mechanism — scores as low as a blunt onyx template. Because the seed is unpredictable until the previous epoch closes, a sybil farm cannot pre-compute a library of passable answers to spread across its fakes.
